def transform(grid):
    # Single-color sparse marks denote vertices; fill the axis-aligned envelope among the marks.
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==7]
    if not pts: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            out[r][c]=7
    return out
PY
